description: Live protocol numbers read from the on-chain factory: fund creation fee and locked seed (USDC), entry/exit fee bps and their creator/platform split, the Season 0 per-fund cap, the basket rule (2-10 tokens, USDC included) and the default policy every fund runs. Quote fees and seed only from here. The per-fund cap in dollars is `season0.fundNavCapUsd`; `factory.zapperOnlyMint: true` means only zapper deposits can mint shares (a flag, not an amount).
